author: Mark Atwood
text: Recommendation ratified after no pushback in ~41 hours: option (a) — drop from_raw_digest, add impl From<&[u8; 32]> for Sha256 (and optionally From<[u8; 32]>). With .18=(A) ratified (keep String), the inner-repr concern is gone but the trait-shape idiom still holds: infallible conversion = From impl. Workspace canonical-templates rule favors using From for infallible conversion.
